sessions.title: Priority: chipping distance and putting
sessions.purpose: Create shorter first putts after recovery and distinguish long-putt leave quality from 5–10-foot conversion.

blocks.name: Warm-up + arrival
blocks.instructions:
First 2 minutes — arrival routine:
30 seconds: Feel your feet; notice tension and your GREEN/YELLOW/RED state without judging it.
60 seconds: Breathe naturally. When expectations show up, acknowledge them and return attention to breathing.
30 seconds: Set the intention: “Some shots will miss. Choose, commit, then give the next shot my attention.”
Remaining 3 minutes — physical warm-up: Roll easy putts to establish green speed.

blocks.name: Chipping distance control
blocks.instructions: Five balls each from three positions with a familiar club. Record starting distance and lie; choose a landing spot, then measure finish distance and short/long for all 15. Keep all outcomes.

blocks.name: Long-putt pace
blocks.instructions: 12 first putts alternating 30, 45 and 60 feet. Record each leave distance and direction; count finishes within three feet. This is a lag sample, not a hole-out total.

blocks.name: 5–10-foot conversion
blocks.instructions: 12 putts: four each from 5, 7 and 10 feet, varying position. Record makes/attempts separately by distance; use your established routine.

blocks.name: Five recovery holes
blocks.instructions: Five varied chip-and-putt holes, one ball each; hole out. Record total strokes, first-putt distance, repeated chips, up-and-downs and three-putts. If time expires, record actual attempts rather than rushing.

success_criteria: Record 15 chip finish distances and short/long outcomes with starting lie and distance
Record conversion attempts/makes at 5, 7 and 10 feet
Record actual recovery holes completed, first-putt distance and strokes; no required success percentage
sessions.process_commitment: Choose the landing spot or pace, commit, then accept the information.

sessions.title: Approaches: consolidate the 50% GIR round
sessions.purpose: Build on 9/18 GIR at Escena, which Ian reports is well above his average. Retain the routine and contact work that may be transferring; monitor the left pattern without assuming a swing fault.

blocks.name: Warm-up + arrival
blocks.instructions:
First 2 minutes — arrival routine:
30 seconds: Feel your feet; notice tension and your GREEN/YELLOW/RED state without judging it.
60 seconds: Breathe naturally. When expectations show up, acknowledge them and return attention to breathing.
30 seconds: Set the intention: “Some shots will miss. Choose, commit, then give the next shot my attention.”
Remaining 3 minutes — physical warm-up: Easy wedges and 8i; find balanced rhythm.

blocks.name: Low point
blocks.instructions: Slapshot rehearsals then 9-to-3 8i; progress to full swings. Define acceptable contact.

blocks.name: Long-approach sample
blocks.instructions: Randomize 6i, 7i and 8i to appropriate targets. Record carry, lateral finish, target and club for at least 10 shots; use a natural committed swing. Check alignment before the set. Observe left misses without presuming face, path or rotation caused them.

blocks.name: Transfer
blocks.instructions: Three simulated par-3s at varied distances; one ball per hole, no mulligans.

blocks.name: Diary
blocks.instructions: Record contact success, sample sizes, misses, and one takeaway.

success_criteria: Record at least 10 long-approach shots with carry and lateral deviation
Log contact quality for a 10-shot randomized iron sample
Record GIR and decision/execution notes for three simulated holes
Take the two-minute arrival pause and choose the intention. Success does not require feeling calm or hitting the first ball perfectly.
sessions.process_commitment: Choose the target, commit, and swing without steering.

sessions.title: If time permits: short-game transfer
sessions.purpose: Consolidate the dedicated session through varied lies and hole-out practice. Flexible third practice, not a quota.

60 seconds: Breathe naturally. When expectations show up, acknowledge them and return attention to breathing.

Remaining 3 minutes — physical warm-up: Easy chips to establish contact and landing spots.

blocks.name: Chip and pitch variability
blocks.instructions: Record 10 chips from varied defined lies. Choose landing spot before each; record starting distance, finish distance and short/long. Compare patterns with the first dedicated session.

blocks.name: Bunker / difficult lie
blocks.instructions: If bunker available, attempt 10 greenside escapes; otherwise use rough/tight/uneven lies and mark bunker baseline pending.

blocks.name: Nine-ball up-and-down challenge
blocks.instructions: Nine varied recovery positions, one ball each, hole out. Record first-putt distance, second-putt leave when applicable, total strokes and up-and-downs. Log actual holes completed if time is limited.

blocks.name: Diary and gratitude
blocks.instructions: Record proximity, escapes, up-and-downs, one lesson and one thing appreciated.

success_criteria: Record 10 chip outcomes with a defined starting lie
Record bunker or difficult-lie results without conflating them
Complete nine up-and-down attempts and count successes
Take the two-minute arrival pause and choose the intention. Success does not require feeling calm or hitting the first ball perfectly.
sessions.process_commitment: A miss is a new problem to solve, not a reason to be frustrated.

sessions.title: Deferred: driver session replaced by Escena
sessions.purpose: Completed Escena round on November 24 occupies this weekly slot: 88 strokes, 11/13 fairways, zero penalties. The 55-minute practice below is retained for future use only; it is not the round duration or work due this week.

blocks.name: Driver corridor
blocks.instructions: Hit 12 drivers to a realistic landing corridor. Record playable/not, carry/total if available, starting direction and major miss.

blocks.name: Simulator decision challenge
blocks.instructions: Play 4–5 holes. Before each consequential shot choose club, target and safe miss. No mulligans. Record decision quality separately from execution.

blocks.name: Diary
blocks.instructions: Record playable-drive rate, penalties, decision notes and next priority.

success_criteria: Record 12 driver outcomes and playable corridor definition
Evaluate at least five consequential decisions before judging outcomes
Separate decision errors from execution errors
Take the two-minute arrival pause and choose the intention. Success does not require feeling calm or hitting the first ball perfectly.
sessions.process_commitment: Decide first, then trust the swing.
